name: paper-trading-terminal
description: An educational paper-trading terminal for Indian equities.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "corepack pnpm --filter @paper-terminal/api dev" "corepack pnpm --filter @paper-terminal/web dev"
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @paper-terminal/contracts build && corepack pnpm --recursive --if-present test
